items.title: Google for Startups Accelerator: Africa
items.text:
Host: Google for Startups
Location: Hybrid
Applications open: 4 February 2026
Deadline: 18 March 2026

A three-month accelerator program for growth-stage technology startups across Africa.

A global series of programs Each cohort of 10-15 startups comes together to tackle technical challenges that can help grow their businesses through a mix of remote and in-person, 1-to-1, group learning sessions, and sprint projects.
